name: deft
description: Deft: highlighting, diagnostics, hover, outline, formatting and C/C++ navigation for X-macro .def tables

deft.colors.macro.patternErrorMessage: Use a color like #RRGGBB, or leave empty to use the theme.
deft.colors.macro.markdownDescription: Color of the macro name in X-macro tables, as `#RRGGBB`. Empty uses the theme.

deft.colors.id.patternErrorMessage: Use a color like #RRGGBB, or leave empty to use the theme.
deft.colors.id.markdownDescription: Color of the id (first argument) in X-macro tables, as `#RRGGBB`. Empty uses the theme.

deft.colors.name.patternErrorMessage: Use a color like #RRGGBB, or leave empty to use the theme.
deft.colors.name.markdownDescription: Color of the name (first identifier after the id) in X-macro tables, as `#RRGGBB`. Empty uses the theme.

deft.colors.number.patternErrorMessage: Use a color like #RRGGBB, or leave empty to use the theme.
deft.colors.number.markdownDescription: Color of the numbers in X-macro tables, as `#RRGGBB`. Empty uses the theme.

deft.colors.string.patternErrorMessage: Use a color like #RRGGBB, or leave empty to use the theme.
deft.colors.string.markdownDescription: Color of the strings in X-macro tables, as `#RRGGBB`. Empty uses the theme.

deft.colors.placeholder.patternErrorMessage: Use a color like #RRGGBB, or leave empty to use the theme.
deft.colors.placeholder.markdownDescription: Color of the {n} placeholders in strings in X-macro tables, as `#RRGGBB`. Empty uses the theme.

deft.colors.use.patternErrorMessage: Use a color like #RRGGBB, or leave empty to turn the highlighting off.
deft.colors.use.markdownDescription: Color of table names used in other files (code), as `#RRGGBB`. Empty turns the highlighting off.
